subject: Installation photograph from a Family of Man touring-edition venue — 'Lay-out' series. Captured by USIA / USAID staff photographers between 1961 and 1979 per the NARA / DPLA descriptive metadata; the image documents how Paul Rudolph's 1955 MoMA design was re-fabricated for the world tour. The exact venue is not identified by the NARA record — these are surviving 'Family of Man Exhibit' photographs in the U.S. National Archives Still Pictures collection (DPLA UUID f7639f1bd10b3415c580d36076fe9800).
